statements.text: Preserve repository-owned framework, component, styling, and dependency conventions unless the task explicitly changes them.

Keep authored changes within the declared allowlist: src/app/features/article/pages/editor/editor.component.ts, src/app/features/article/pages/editor/*.spec.ts. Do not edit forbidden paths: src/app/** (except allowed paths), package.json, package-lock.json, realworld/**, .github/**.
Keep the repository build and task-specific host checks passing under the frozen environment contract.

review.notes: Approved after changing the selector to the base-defined /editor/:slug route. Built task context resolves it uniquely to the production editor component; Angular CSS authority exists, scope text matches the candidate, and the guard now excludes test, generated, and build lanes.
